items.quote: Für diese Kündigung haben Sie drei Monate Zeit, gerechnet ab dem Zugang dieser Mitteilung; wirksam wird sie frühestens an dem Tag, an dem der neue Preis gilt.
items.computation: Sender is a private company, not a German authority, so the statutory Bekanntgabefiktion for authorities does not apply; the three-month period instead runs from actual Zugang (receipt) of the letter. The letter is dated Saturday 21.11.2026; no separate posting date is given. Lacking an explicit receipt date, I assume ordinary domestic letter-post delivery of about 3 days, giving an estimated Zugang on Tuesday 24.11.2026 (today). Under §187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of receipt itself is not counted; the three-month period (§188 Abs. 2 BGB) then ends on the day with the same calendar-day number three months later: 24.11.2026 + 3 months = 24.02.2027. 24.02.2027 falls on a Wednesday (24.11.2026 Tue + 92 days → 92 mod 7 = 1 → Wednesday), so no weekend/holiday shift under §193 BGB is needed. This is the last day the cancellation declaration must reach the provider; the cancellation itself only takes effect at the earliest once the new price applies (01.01.2027), but since that date already lies before the computed deadline it does not change the due date.
